name: ai-blog
description: AI daily and weekly publishing workflow built on AI_News_Digest outputs.

scripts.demo: npm run daily:render -- --markdown examples/daily/sample-daily.md --csv examples/daily/sample-daily.csv --out output/daily/sample-daily.html && npm run weekly:build -- --weekly-md examples/weekly/sample-weekly.md --out-md output/weekly/sample-weekly.md --out-html output/weekly/sample-weekly.html --out-xml output/weekly/sample-weekly.xml && npm run verify -- --markdown examples/daily/sample-daily.md --csv examples/daily/sample-daily.csv --html output/daily/sample-daily.html
